definitions.accuracy: share of scored questions with is_correct True (QA: EM or token F1 >= 0.8)
definitions.mean_f1: mean token F1 over questions with an f1 value (QA only)
definitions.right_to_wrong_rate: of questions the baseline got right, share the config got wrong
definitions.propagation_rate: share of judged questions with error_propagated True (needs step rows run with --baseline)
definitions.cost_ratio: config cost / baseline cost summed over paired questions
definitions.p_holm: Holm-Bonferroni adjusted within pipeline and metric
definitions.delta_accuracy_ci: Bonett-Price adjusted Wald interval for the paired difference
definitions.delta_f1_ci: percentile bootstrap interval of the mean paired F1 difference
definitions.verdict: too few if fewer than 20 paired questions; non-inferior if CI lower bound > -0.05; worse if CI upper bound < 0 and Holm p < 0.05; worse (unadjusted) if CI upper bound < 0 but Holm p is not below 0.05; otherwise inconclusive

warnings: qa: the common-ids frontier is based on the 23 question_ids every config answered
sql: fewer than 20 questions for all-flash, cheap-decomposer, cheap-refiner, cheap-selector; treat those intervals as indicative only
